crosswind.direction: square across the rail's heading, blowing toward its right, the same at every height

flown.equations: as the pinned commit has them: it carries pull request #1196's correction to the sign of the center-of-mass vector, which the reference's script (tip_off.py) checks on the commit's source before it flies, and #1188's to the nozzle's jet-damping lever
flown.evaluation: What RocketPy's tip-off phase (udot_rail2) moves: each example rocket flown with the phase off and on, in still air and in a 20 mph crosswind; moved is on less off, and moved_from_guided is on less a flight with the phase off on a rail longer by the button spacing, which frees the rocket, unturned, where the lower button leaves
flown.phase_off: the commit's own branch for a rocket without a pair of buttons on the rail, reached by reading the lower button's rail length as equal to the upper one's: free flight from where the upper button leaves
